source.snippet: I have many files stored in my personal OneDrive account, and I suspect that several files are duplicated. I want to remove unnecessary copies without accidentally deleting important data. I am looking for a safe and reliable method to identify duplicate files. Is there any built-in OneDrive option or recommended approach for this? I would appreciate simple steps, as I am new to managing cloud storage.

problem_statement: OneDrive users accumulate duplicate files with no native deduplication tool, leading to wasted storage and confusion; existing third-party tools are either too technical or not OneDrive-specific.
target_segment: Non-technical individual and SMB OneDrive users who manage large file repositories and pay for Microsoft 365 storage tiers.
notes: Recurrent question type across cloud storage platforms. Buyer signal is moderate: users paying for OneDrive storage upgrades have direct financial motivation to clean up. A simple web app or Office Add-in that scans and previews duplicates before deletion could command a one-time or subscription fee. Signal is a single post but represents a highly repeated class of complaint.
